claims.subject: cMutexMerge2_8b
claims.summary: Arbitration merger that selects between two writeback drive sources (WB and EX) and forwards the winner to the FIFO.
claims.explanation: This MutexMerge instance receives two event drives: i_psrDriveFromWB_1 (writeback stage) and i_psrwDriveFromExp_1 (execute stage). It acts as a mutual-exclusion merger, meaning only one drive is allowed to pass at a time. The output w_driveTopsr carries the selected drive to the next stage. The merger introduces a blocking point where event propagation may be gated if both drives arrive simultaneously.
